data.name: Sword and Immortal
data.detailed_description:
《Sword and Immortal》is a magnificent action‑packed RPG immortal cultivation game. Boasting stunning scenes, exquisite visuals, profound storylines and endless romantic bonds, it perfectly interprets the charm of traditional Chinese style with ethereal sea‑city pavilions and mist‑shrouded sacred mountains. Built on a grand world background and twisting plots, it poignantly re‑creates an epic ballad of immortal heroes.

Rooted in a magnificent Eastern xianxia worldview, the game features fluid action‑oriented combat systems that immerse players in an expansive cultivation world. Crafted with top‑tier art design, every detail is polished with delicate lighting and lifelike modeling. Wander through rolling sea‑of‑cloud sacred peaks, mist‑veiled holy mountains, mirage‑like jade palaces and serene hidden valleys. Every blade of grass and tree carries ancient charm, and every view reflects oriental elegance, just like an ink painting scroll, letting you fully experience the grandeur and romance of the immortal realm.

The game unfolds profound main quests and dramatic side stories set across the Nine Provinces and Three Realms, weaving together ancient secrets, conflicts between immortals and demons, sect feuds, and karmic cycles of fate. From mortal cultivation and spiritual foundation building to heavenly tribulation transcendence and dominion over heaven and earth, winding storylines unfold step by step, interwoven with touching immortal romances. Full of love and hatred, struggles between good and evil, righteousness and friendship, the game narrates a thousand‑year‑long xianxia epic, allowing every player to encounter their own destiny and journey.

From the summit of cloud seas to the depths of the Nine Hells, from prosperous immortal cities to primeval secret realms,《 Sword and Immortal》 gathers all the romance, passion, tenderness and chivalry of traditional xianxia. Here you may soar above the Nine Provinces on a flying sword, slay demons with your blade to uphold justice, meet soulmates for eternal love, or stand atop the peak to forge your own legend. Step into this world of the Nine Provinces, embark on your own immortal journey, and write your exclusive xianxia tale among mountains, seas and wind and moon.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2GB / AMD Radeon R7 370 2GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
